import os import time from unittest import TestCase import mistune class TestAutoseIssue3FR001(TestCase): def test_link_rel_specified(self): """AC-FR-001-1: Given renderer equals mistune.HTMLRenderer(link_rel="nofollow ugc") and md equals mistune.create_markdown(renderer=renderer), when calling md("[site](https://example.com)"), then the return value equals "

site

\n".""" renderer = mistune.HTMLRenderer(link_rel="nofollow ugc") md = mistune.create_markdown(renderer=renderer) self.assertEqual( md("[site](https://example.com)"), '

site

\n', ) def test_link_rel_default(self): """AC-FR-001-2: Given renderer equals mistune.HTMLRenderer() and md equals mistune.create_markdown(renderer=renderer), when calling md("[site](https://example.com)"), then the return value equals "

site

\n".""" renderer = mistune.HTMLRenderer() md = mistune.create_markdown(renderer=renderer) self.assertEqual( md("[site](https://example.com)"), '

site

\n', ) def test_benchmark_execution_time_overhead(self): """AC-NFR-001-1: Metric: execution time overhead | Threshold: zero regression | Conditions: rendering standard benchmark test suite | Method: benchmark test execution time comparison.""" root_dir = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "benchmark")) cases_dir = os.path.join(root_dir, "cases") case_names = [ "atx", "auto_links", "blockhtml", "blockquote", "emphasis", "fenced", "normal_ol", "normal_ul", "paragraph", "std_links" ] contents = [] for name in case_names: path = os.path.join(cases_dir, f"{name}.txt") if os.path.exists(path): with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f: contents.append(f.read()) if not contents: contents = ["# Heading\n\n[site](https://example.com) test paragraph with *emphasis*.\n"] * 5 md_default = mistune.create_markdown(renderer=mistune.HTMLRenderer()) md_with_rel = mistune.create_markdown(renderer=mistune.HTMLRenderer(link_rel="nofollow ugc")) # Warmup for content in contents: md_default(content) md_with_rel(content) # Measure default start_default = time.perf_counter() for _ in range(50): for content in contents: md_default(content) duration_default = time.perf_counter() - start_default # Measure with link_rel start_with_rel = time.perf_counter() for _ in range(50): for content in contents: md_with_rel(content) duration_with_rel = time.perf_counter() - start_with_rel self.assertLessEqual( duration_with_rel, duration_default * 2.5 + 0.1, f"Execution time with link_rel ({duration_with_rel:.4f}s) significantly exceeded default ({duration_default:.4f}s)." )
